verdict.rationale: MX documents a first-party capability to "Get the available balance for an end user's financial accounts." That is a direct balance feature for connected accounts. The evidence is only a one-line product description, though. Nothing shows it pulls a live, on-demand balance rather than aggregated data, and the only refresh detail cited is the roughly 24-hour aggregation cadence. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time/on-demand balance refresh, documented balance endpoint reference details, explicit positioning for NSF/pre-payment risk checks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch a real-time balance for a connected account before initiating a payment — a documented balance endpoint intended for NSF and risk checks
